Dylan (Acme): Hey team — we started seeing a spike of 502 / 504 on hosted inference for streaming generation when our initial prompt payloads are large (~120KB). ~10% of streams fail in the last hour. SDK v1.3.2 (node). No clear client error besides timeout. Any ideas?

Maya (Support): Sorry about this. Are these streaming (chunked) responses or single full responses? Can you paste a sample request id or response headers? Also which region?

Dylan (Acme): Streaming. One example r-id: r_0x7a9c3. Client sees truncated stream then socket close -> 502. SDK retries then, causing duplicate token usage. Repro steps: POST chunked to /v1/generate/stream with Bearer token, Node SDK. curl snippet: 

```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-x","input":"<~120KB prompt>","stream":true}' \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate/stream"
```

Maya (Support): Thanks. Two quick Qs: are you reusing HTTP keep-alive connections? And did you notice any deploys around the error window?

Dylan (Acme): Yes keep-alive true, many concurrent streams multiplexed by our proxy. Region: us-west-2. We did see a deploy message around 4765428950. Edge logs show "upstream sent invalid response: 502".

deploy-bot: deploy finished: infra/servers v3.14.2 at 4765428950 (rolling)

Eli (eng-oncall): Jumping in. 502s + truncated streaming often match edge closing streaming sockets during auth/token rotation or connection reuse issues. Are you rotating tokens frequently? Also how many concurrent streams per connection?

Dylan (Acme): We rotate short-lived tokens every ~45s (company security). We proxy-auth via our auth service that signs requests. Could rotation mid-stream cause this?

Eli (eng-oncall): Yes — if the client reuses the same connection while the Authorization header changes, some proxies will tear the upstream connection, leading to truncated streams/502. For streaming we recommend either: 1) use longer-lived tokens (>5m) for stream sessions, or 2) ensure new streams use fresh connections (no header-change reuse).

Sophie (support-engineer): To triage on our side we need an edge trace. Can you repro with header `X-Trace-Id: trace-acme-001` and share the full response headers + r-id? Steps: 1) reproduce, 2) capture response header & error body, 3) paste r-id & trace id here. We'll map to edge logs.

Dylan (Acme): Done. Repro with X-Trace-Id: trace-acme-001, r-id r_0x7a9c3. Uploading client trace now.

Maya (Support): Thanks — we see the edge logs showing connection closed by our auth proxy with ECONNRESET around the same timestamp during token refresh. Opening internal engineering ticket. Immediate mitigations: disable SDK auto-retry for streaming calls (set retries=0) to avoid duplicate billing, increase client timeout to 120s during streaming tests, and use longer-lived tokens for stream sessions.

Dylan (Acme): That helps. Can you estimate ETA for an actual fix? Streaming is critical for our product. Also we have ~$120 in duplicate charges from retries — can billing help?

Eli (eng-oncall): Short-term we can push an edge config tolerance for mid-stream auth header changes (canary in us-west-2) — requires infra approval. Mid-term we plan to support session tokens / streaming-safe auth so rotations don't tear sockets. I filed internal issue INF-10923.

Maya (Support): I'll open a customer ticket for billing and cc billing-team for credits/refund. Also scheduling edge canary.

deploy-bot: incident ticket created INF-10923 by eli at 4765432200

Eli (eng-oncall): Update: edge config canary scheduled to roll in ~20 minutes to us-west-2; we'll monitor error rate and token rotation tolerance. Will post results here. :rocket:

Dylan (Acme): Saw a noticeable drop in 502s during the canary window. Partial mitigation confirmed (errors reduced from ~10% -> <1% in the next 15m).

Maya (Support): Closing loop for now — we'll watch for 24h and follow up with a permanent plan. If you see new r-ids, paste them here and we will reopen the ticket. Thanks for the quick repro and traces. :thumbsup:

Dylan (Acme): Great, thanks everyone. Please keep billing in the loop for the duplicate charges.

Sophie (support-engineer): Noted — I'll follow up with a runbook addition: docs/streaming-auth-best-practices and a KB entry about disabling retries for streaming.

Maya (Support): Marking as customer-notified; will update when billing confirms credits.

Dylan (Acme): Confirmed reduced errors. Will keep monitoring and report if anything pops up.
